The experiment for gate_40 shows a statistically significant negative effect on retention_7 (primary metric). The treatment arm had an 18.2% retention rate compared to 19.02% in the control, representing a -0.82 percentage point difference with a p-value of 0.00155, which is below the alpha threshold of 0.05. While the experiment was adequately powered (96.63% power at the pre-registered effect size), the observed effect works against the treatment goal. Given that the sample ratio check passed and the data is trustworthy, I recommend not shipping gate_40 as it fails to meet the primary metric objective.
